title: Fastest Blaze Farm In Minecraft 1.19+ (+100k/h)--- White Mc ---
description:
The farm presented in the video is world fastest blaze farm that can be made in 1.19+.  
To make this farm, you should install minihud to see the borders of the nether fortress that you will use to make this farm.
This farm is made in a perimeter to reduce lag and to higher the rates.
It is possible to make the farm smaller, but the rates will lower too.
